description: This file defines a web scraper function for extracting recipe data from 'simplyrecipes.com' pages. It uses 'request' to fetch HTML content and 'cheerio' to parse and extract specific recipe details, then returns a Promise resolving to a Recipe object.

methods.name: simplyRecipes
methods.description: Main function that takes a URL, fetches the webpage, parses the HTML to extract recipe details, and returns a Promise resolving to a Recipe object.
